about: Producer: notes/halo_ia_models/plots/make_figure_data.py from analysis/halo_nlbias/nlbias_fits.json. Best-fit parameters per k_max at z = 0.3, 1, 2 (A1, A2, bTA, a_c, W, alpha, a_1h); at_bound marks a parameter within 1 percent of its bound (A1 in [0, 20], A2 in [-5, 5], b_TA in [0, 2], a_c in [0, 1], alpha in [-1, 2]). Fixed parameters are at their fixed value.
